title: FinTech and vertical integration in emerging economies: evidence from China
title_zh: 金融科技与新兴经济体的垂直整合：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 金融科技与新兴经济体的垂直整合：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: FinTech and vertical integration in emerging economies: evidence from China
authors: Rui Cheng, Jiameng Zhang, Yan Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: With the rapid development of China’s FinTech, this study considers China as an example to explore the impact of FinTech on vertical integration in developing countries. The research results reveal the following. First, the development of FinTech has significantly increased vertical integration, indicating that FinTech can enhance the security of industrial and supply chains. Second, such development has reduced the information asymmetry between banks and enterprises and alleviated the financing constraints of enterprises. Third, it has also improved the digital management level of enterprises and enhanced their internal governance ability. Fourth, FinTech is more conducive to increasing vertical integration in private enterprises, smaller enterprises, start-up and growth-stage enterprises, high-tech industry enterprises, and export enterprises. KEYWORDS: FinTech vertical integration financing constraints internal governance ability JEL CLASSIFICATION: G30 L22 O14
abstract_zh: 随着中国金融科技的快速发展，本研究以中国为例，探讨金融科技对发展中国家纵向整合的影响。研究结果揭示如下：第一，金融科技的发展显著提升了纵向整合水平，表明金融科技能够增强产业链与供应链的安全性。第二，这种发展降低了银行与企业之间的信息不对称，缓解了企业的融资约束。第三，金融科技还提高了企业的数字化管理水平，增强了其内部治理能力。第四，金融科技更有利于提升民营企业、小型企业、初创及成长期企业、高科技行业企业以及出口企业的纵向整合程度。关键词：金融科技 纵向整合 融资约束 内部治理能力 JEL分类：G30 L22 O14

title: Sustainability of Public Finances
title_zh: 公共财政的可持续性
title_primary: 公共财政的可持续性
title_secondary: Sustainability of Public Finances
authors: Jurgen von Hagen, Roberto Perotti, Rolf Strauch, Willem Buiter, Luiz de Mello 等
official: 官方在线 1997-11-30 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this study, we develop a concept of sustainability focusing on the controllability of public finances. In so doing, we adopt the approach of the Maastricht Treaty, to assume sustainability as long as a country does not violate the double standards of the deficit (3%) and the debt (60% of GDP) criterion. When the benign assumption does not hold, we distinguish between the symptoms of non-sustainability of public finances, which can be determined in a relatively straightforward way, and the underlying institutional causes, which are more difficult to identify. Correcting the symptoms requires a disaggregate view of the government budget. Successful consolidation requires the fiscal policy problem to be addressed ?at the source?, i.e. the adjustment of those items of the government budget that produced the build-up of a non-sustainable deficit in the first place. Lasting consolidation also requires a correction of the institutional weaknesses that are the ultimate causes of a non-sustainable deficit. After reviewing the theoretical and empirical arguments for a disaggregate and institutions-oriented approach to correcting non-sustainable deficits, we propose a practical procedure to assess the sustainability of a country?s public finances.
abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种聚焦于公共财政可控性的可持续性概念。为此，我们采用《马斯特里赫特条约》的分析框架，将可持续性定义为：只要一国未违反赤字（占GDP的3%）与债务（占GDP的60%）双重标准，即视为具备可持续性。当这一良性假设不成立时，我们需区分公共财政不可持续性的两类表征：一类是可通过相对直接方式判定的症状，另一类则是更难以识别的深层制度性成因。纠正症状需要对政府预算进行分项审视。成功的财政整顿要求从源头解决财政政策问题，即首先调整那些导致不可持续性赤字累积的政府预算项目。持久的财政整顿还需修正作为不可持续性赤字根本诱因的制度缺陷。在梳理以分项分析与制度导向方法纠正不可持续性赤字问题的理论与实证依据后，本文提出了一套评估一国公共财政可持续性的实践操作流程。

title: Online sales and the expansion of enterprises’ innovation boundaries: on the innovation incentive of digital-real integration
title_zh: 线上销售与企业创新边界扩张：数字实体融合的创新激励研究
title_primary: 线上销售与企业创新边界扩张：数字实体融合的创新激励研究
title_secondary: Online sales and the expansion of enterprises’ innovation boundaries: on the innovation incentive of digital-real integration
authors: Xiaowei Xing, Min-Kyu Lee, Sheng Xu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Online sales have been deepening the integration of digital and real economies and driving enterprise development in recent years, but their impact on the expansion of enterprises’ innovation boundaries remains underexplored. Based on constructing a heterogeneous innovation theory model, this paper conducts empirical tests using two-way fixed‑effects models, combined with unbalanced panel data of A-share listed enterprises from 2015 to 2024. The results showed that online sales significantly expand enterprises’ innovation boundaries and help increase the number of patents. From mechanism perspectives, online sales encourage companies’ substantive technological innovation, resulting in technological breakthroughs through broadening market information channels, promoting knowledge and technology spillovers and altering enterprises’ innovation strategies. Heterogeneity analyses revealed that the effect of online sales is more pronounced for enterprises with a higher degree of digital transformation, larger scale and low market share. This study provides new empirical evidence for exploring how online sales can be leveraged to empower enterprise innovation and the innovation incentives of digital-real integration
abstract_zh: 近年来，线上销售持续深化数字经济与实体经济的融合，并驱动企业发展，但其对企业创新边界拓展的影响尚未得到充分探究。本文在构建异质性创新理论模型的基础上，采用双向固定效应模型，结合2015—2024年A股上市企业非平衡面板数据进行实证检验。结果表明，线上销售显著拓展了企业的创新边界，并有助于增加专利数量。从机制视角来看，线上销售通过拓宽市场信息渠道、促进知识和技术溢出以及改变企业创新策略，鼓励企业开展实质性技术创新，从而实现技术突破。异质性分析显示，对于数字化转型程度较高、规模较大且市场份额较低的企业，线上销售的影响更为显著。本研究为探索如何利用线上销售赋能企业创新以及数字融合的创新激励提供了新的经验证据。

title: Better Together? The Impact of Cash Transfers and Couples' Financial Planning on Household Dynamics and Economic Outcomes
title_zh: 携手共进？现金转移与夫妻财务规划对家庭动态及经济结果的影响
title_primary: 携手共进？现金转移与夫妻财务规划对家庭动态及经济结果的影响
title_secondary: Better Together? The Impact of Cash Transfers and Couples' Financial Planning on Household Dynamics and Economic Outcomes
authors: Sarika Gupta, Jessica Leight, Daniel W. Maggio, Simone G. Schaner
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Households' most consequential economic decisions are usually made jointly, yet behavioral interventions are typically targeted to individuals and optimized to overcome intra-personal constraints. We use a randomized controlled trial to study whether behavioral interventions targeted to couples can overcome interpersonal constraints related to intra-household decision-making. In rural Liberia, we layer a facilitated joint financial planning exercise atop a large unconditional cash transfer, assessing effects relative to cash only and a pure control. Relative to cash only, adding planning increases the amount of the transfer spent on productive investment and consequently improves economic outcomes by 0.16 standard deviation units. However, for households with the highest ex-ante conflict risk, these gains come at the cost of additional intimate partner violence.
abstract_zh: 家庭最重要的经济决策通常由夫妻共同做出，然而行为干预措施通常针对个人设计，并优化以克服个人内在约束。我们通过一项随机对照试验，研究针对夫妻的行为干预能否克服与家庭内部决策相关的人际约束。在利比里亚农村地区，我们在大规模无条件现金转移支付的基础上，增加了一项引导式联合财务规划练习，评估其相对于仅提供现金和纯对照组的效果。与仅提供现金相比，增加财务规划使转移支付中用于生产性投资的金额增加，进而使经济结果改善0.16个标准差单位。然而，对于事前冲突风险最高的家庭，这些收益是以增加亲密伴侣暴力为代价的。

title: Dealing with Destabilizing 'Market Discipline'
title_zh: 应对破坏稳定的“市场纪律
title_primary: 应对破坏稳定的“市场纪律
title_secondary: Dealing with Destabilizing 'Market Discipline'
authors: Daniel Cohen, Richard Portes
official: 官方在线 2004-02-23 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: If interest rates (country spreads) rise, debt can rapidly be subject to a snowball effect, which then becomes self-fulfilling with regard to the fundamentals themselves.This is a market imperfection, because we cannot be confident that the unaided market will choose the "good equilibrium" over the "bad equilibrium".We see here a fundamental flaw in the process of market discipline.We propose a policy intervention to deal with this structural weakness in the mechanisms of international capital flows.This is based on a simple taxonomy that enables us to break down the origin of crises into three components: a crisis of confidence (spreads and currency crisis), a crisis of fundamentals (real growth rate), and a crisis of economic policy (primary deficit).The policy would seek to shortcircuit confidence crises, partly by using IMF support to improve ex ante incentives.
abstract_zh: 如果利率（国家利差）上升，债务可能迅速陷入雪球效应，进而对基本面本身产生自我实现的机制。这是一种市场缺陷，因为我们无法确信未受干预的市场会在“坏均衡”与“好均衡”之间选择后者。在此，我们看到了市场纪律运行过程中的一个根本性缺陷。为此，我们提出一项政策干预方案，以应对国际资本流动机制中的这一结构性弱点。该方案基于一个简单的分类框架，将危机根源分解为三个组成部分：信心危机（利差与货币危机）、基本面危机（实际增长率）以及经济政策危机（基本赤字）。该政策旨在通过部分借助国际货币基金组织的支持来改善事前激励，从而阻断信心危机的传导链条。

title: Effects of water scarcity on Peru’s long-term growth potential: a general equilibrium model-based quantitative assessment
title_zh: 水资源短缺对秘鲁长期增长潜力的影响：基于一般均衡模型的量化评估
title_primary: 水资源短缺对秘鲁长期增长潜力的影响：基于一般均衡模型的量化评估
title_secondary: Effects of water scarcity on Peru’s long-term growth potential: a general equilibrium model-based quantitative assessment
authors: Jean-Marc Montaud, Nicolas Pécastaing
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study quantifies the impact of water scarcity on Peru’s long-term growth potential using a Computable General Equilibrium model that explicitly represents water as a production factor in selected activities and incorporates mobility constraints on its allocation across sectors. The model is calibrated on a Social Accounting Matrix of the economy that has been specifically extended to capture water-related features. Simulations are conducted based on climate change-induced reductions in water availability projected for 2050 in the Pacific coastal region, the country’s economic core and the area most exposed to water stress. The results highlight the economic and welfare costs associated with increased water scarcity, as well as its differentiated impacts across sectors. They also confirm that the degree of substitutability between water and other production factors, as well as the degree of water mobility across sectors, jointly determine the capacity of the economy to adapt to water scarcity.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用可计算一般均衡模型，量化了水资源短缺对秘鲁长期增长潜力的影响。该模型将水明确列为特定生产活动中的生产要素，并纳入了跨部门水资源配置的流动性约束。模型基于经特别扩展以捕捉水资源相关特征的社会核算矩阵进行校准。模拟依据气候变化导致的水资源可用性减少预测展开，该预测针对2050年秘鲁太平洋沿岸地区——该国经济核心区域及水资源压力最严重地区。结果凸显了水资源短缺加剧带来的经济与福利成本，及其对各部门的差异化影响。研究同时证实，水与其他生产要素之间的替代程度，以及水在各部门间的流动性程度，共同决定了经济适应水资源短缺的能力。关键词：水资源短缺；可计算一般均衡模型；秘鲁 JEL分类：Q25 Q56 C68

title: Procyclical Fiscal Policy and Asset Market Incompleteness
title_zh: 顺周期财政政策与资产市场不完全性
title_primary: 顺周期财政政策与资产市场不完全性
title_secondary: Procyclical Fiscal Policy and Asset Market Incompleteness
authors: Fernández, Andrés, Guzman, Daniel, Lama, Ruy, Végh, Carlos
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study why government spending and tax policy are procyclical in emerging and developing economies. We develop a model of optimal fiscal policy over the business cycle with financial frictions, captured by asset market incompleteness and debt-elastic interest rate spreads. In a simple static setting, incomplete markets can generate procyclical government spending, but not necessarily procyclical tax policy. Procyclical taxation also requires the ratio of private to public consumption to rise in booms, amplifying tax-base fluctuations. We show that this mechanism carries over to a DSGE model calibrated to emerging markets, implies sizable welfare costs, and is robust to distortionary labor income taxation, downward wage rigidities, and fiscal transfer shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文研究为何新兴经济体和发展中经济体的政府支出与税收政策呈现顺周期性。我们构建了一个包含金融摩擦（以资产市场不完全性和债务弹性利率利差为特征）的经济周期最优财政政策模型。在简单静态设定下，不完全市场可产生顺周期的政府支出，但未必导致顺周期的税收政策。顺周期税收还需满足私人消费与公共消费之比在经济繁荣期上升的条件，这会放大税基波动。我们证明该机制可延伸至校准至新兴市场的DSGE模型，并产生显著的福利成本，且对扭曲性劳动收入税、工资下行刚性及财政转移支付冲击具有稳健性。

title: Perceived importance of digitalization in the European Union: a multilevel analysis of individual and country-level determinants
title_zh: 欧盟数字化感知重要性：个体与国家层面决定因素的多层次分析
title_primary: 欧盟数字化感知重要性：个体与国家层面决定因素的多层次分析
title_secondary: Perceived importance of digitalization in the European Union: a multilevel analysis of individual and country-level determinants
authors: Larisa Stănilă, Maria Denisa Vasilescu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Digital transformation is a central policy priority, yet its benefits remain unevenly distributed across individuals and countries. Digital inequalities are multidimensional, encompassing both objective aspects, such as access, use, and outcomes, and subjective dimensions, including perceptions, motivation, and behaviours. This article examines the factors associated with individuals’ perceptions of the importance of digitalization, using data from Eurobarometer 99.1. The analysis focuses on socio-demographic characteristics, internet use, attitudinal variables related to digital policies, and the national context. Binary and multilevel logistic regression models are employed to account for both individual and country-level influences. The findings show that perceptions of digitalization are more strongly associated with individual factors than with cross-country differences. Socio-economic characteristics are relevant, with education and income positively associated with the perceived importance of digitalization, while age shows a negative association. Attitudinal variables related to digital education, access, and infrastructure display significant associations. At the country level, the share of individuals with basic digital skills (DESI) is positively associated with the perceived importance of digitalization and explains part of the variation between countries. This study contributes to the literature on digital inequalities by focusing on attitudes towards digitalization and by highlighting the interplay between individual and contextual factors.
abstract_zh: 数字化转型是核心政策重点，但其收益在个体和国家间仍分布不均。数字不平等具有多维性，既涵盖接入、使用和结果等客观层面，也包含认知、动机和行为等主观维度。本文利用欧洲晴雨表99.1数据，考察与个体对数字化重要性认知相关的因素。分析聚焦于社会人口特征、互联网使用、与数字政策相关的态度变量以及国家背景。采用二元和多层次逻辑回归模型来同时考虑个体和国家层面的影响。研究结果表明，与跨国差异相比，个体因素与数字化认知的关联更为显著。社会经济特征具有相关性：教育程度和收入与数字化重要性认知呈正相关，而年龄则呈负相关。与数字教育、接入和基础设施相关的态度变量表现出显著关联。在国家层面，具备基础数字技能的人口比例（DESI）与数字化重要性认知呈正相关，并解释了部分国家间差异。本研究通过聚焦数字化态度并强调个体与情境因素的相互作用，为数字不平等文献做出贡献。

title: The gendered effects of rainfall shocks on stunting: Evidence from Papua New Guinea
title_zh: 降雨冲击对发育迟缓的性别差异效应：来自巴布亚新几内亚的证据
title_primary: 降雨冲击对发育迟缓的性别差异效应：来自巴布亚新几内亚的证据
title_secondary: The gendered effects of rainfall shocks on stunting: Evidence from Papua New Guinea
authors: Jessica Leight, Rishabh Mukerjee, Emily Schmidt
official: 官方在线 2026-07-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Rainfall fluctuations significantly reduce welfare for poor rural households in low- and middle-income countries dependent on rainfed agriculture for consumption, and the effects of these shocks can be borne disproportionately by vulnerable household members, particularly children and girls. We present new evidence around the effects of rainfall fluctuations on child anthropometric status in Papua New Guinea, an understudied context characterized by some of the highest stunting rates in the world. We show that negative fluctuations in rainfall within the first 12 months of life lead to a reduction in height-for-age and weight-for-age (though not stunting), but this effect is observed only for girls.
abstract_zh: 降雨波动显著降低了依赖雨养农业维持生计的低收入与中等收入国家贫困农村家庭的福利水平，且此类冲击的影响可能不成比例地由弱势家庭成员（尤其是儿童和女童）承担。我们提供了关于巴布亚新几内亚降雨波动对儿童人体测量学指标影响的新证据——该地区是全球发育迟缓率最高的地区之一，但相关研究尚不充分。研究表明，出生后12个月内降雨量的负向波动会导致年龄别身高和年龄别体重下降（但未达到发育迟缓标准），然而这一效应仅出现在女童群体中。

abstract: I combine newly digitized data on confidence votes, party switches, and tax returns of Italian MPs from 2001 to 2022 to study how tenure-dependent benefits influence politicians’ behaviour and government stability. Using a difference-in-discontinuities design, I find that a tenure requirement for parliamentary pensions introduced in 2008 increased confidence votes for the government, switches to majority parties, and legislative effort. Consistent with agency model predictions, the policy discouraged internal party defiance that could jeopardize reelection chances and pension eligibility for a second term. Tenure requirements increase government stability but also strengthen party control, with ambiguous effects on voters’ welfare.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我整合了2001年至2022年意大利议员的信任投票、政党转换及纳税申报新数字化数据，研究任期相关福利如何影响政治人物行为与政府稳定性。通过断点回归差分设计，我发现2008年引入的议会养老金任期要求增加了对政府的信任投票、向多数党转换的比例以及立法努力。与委托代理模型预测一致，该政策抑制了可能危及连任机会及第二任期养老金资格的内部政党反抗。任期要求提升了政府稳定性，但也强化了政党控制，对选民福利产生模糊影响。

title_secondary: How Video‐Based Information Affects Farmers' Willingness to Pay for Drone Services
authors: Hua Zhang, Lena Kuhn, Hang Xiong, Zhanli Sun, Thomas Glauben
official: 官方在线 2026-06-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Professional service for digital technology like agricultural drones lowers transaction costs and scope thresholds for smallholders. Meanwhile, perceptual adoption barriers remain underexplored. We conduct a two‐stage choice experiment with a randomized video‐based information treatment among 384 Chinese crop farmers to measure its effect on farmers' willingness to pay (WTP) for agricultural drone services (ADS). While video‐based information significantly reduces farmers' WTP for contracts relative to oral agreements, it increases WTP for overall drone services among farmers who are younger, higher‐income, cultivate larger‐scale farms near tractor roads, have limited access to digital dissemination, and show lower risk preferences. By incorporating perceived uncertainty and risk management into the information‐adoption framework, we provide insights for policy support of digital agriculture service markets.
abstract_zh: 农业无人机等数字技术的专业服务降低了小农户的交易成本和规模门槛。然而，感知层面的采用障碍仍未得到充分研究。我们针对384名中国种植农户开展了一项两阶段选择实验，并采用随机视频信息干预措施，以衡量其对农户农业无人机服务支付意愿的影响。研究发现，与口头协议相比，视频信息显著降低了农户对合同的支付意愿，但提高了年轻、高收入、在机耕道附近经营较大规模农场、数字传播渠道有限且风险偏好较低的农户对整体无人机服务的支付意愿。通过将感知不确定性和风险管理纳入信息采纳分析框架，我们为数字农业服务市场的政策支持提供了启示。

authors: MARKUS HAAVIO, JONI HEIKKINEN, PIRKKA JALASJOKI, JUHA KILPONEN, MARITTA PALOVIITA 等
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-05-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Applying a wide range of text analysis techniques, we proxy the central bank's loss by extracting the tone of the central bank's qualitative communication and combine it with real‐time quantitative information to estimate the loss function. We find strong and robust evidence of asymmetry in the case of the European Central Bank during 1999–2021: the slope of the loss function was roughly three times steeper when inflation exceeded the target compared to when it was below the target. This represents a significant departure from the quadratic and symmetric monetary policy loss function typically applied in macromodels.
abstract_zh: 运用多种文本分析技术，我们通过提取央行定性沟通的语调来代理央行的损失，并结合实时定量信息估算损失函数。研究发现，在1999年至2021年期间，欧洲央行存在显著且稳健的非对称性证据：当通胀高于目标时，损失函数的斜率约为低于目标时的三倍。这显著偏离了宏观模型中通常采用的二次对称型货币政策损失函数。

title: The human capital cost of premature mortality: evidence from U.S. counties
title_zh: 过早死亡的人力资本成本：来自美国县级层面的证据
title_primary: 过早死亡的人力资本成本：来自美国县级层面的证据
title_secondary: The human capital cost of premature mortality: evidence from U.S. counties
authors: Ahmad Reshad Osmani Department of Economics and Finance, Louisiana State University (LSU) Shreveport, Shreveport, LA, USA
official: 官方在线 2025-07-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines the economic and structural determinants of premature mortality, measured in years of potential life lost. Using county-level panel data from 2014–2020, covering 2,880 U.S. counties and over 20,000 county-year observations, this study employed an instrumental variables approach to address endogeneity and estimate causal effects. A ten-day increase in mentally unhealthy days per month was associated with a 1.29-year reduction in life expectancy, driven by increased mortality from suicide, drug overdoses, and alcohol-related diseases. A five-percentage-point rise in child poverty led to a 0.72-year decline in life expectancy through food insecurity, adverse childhood experiences, and long-term chronic health conditions. Increasing primary care providers by one per 10,000 residents extended life expectancy by 0.91 years, with larger effects in economically distressed and racially segregated counties. The analysis explored underlying mechanisms linking these determinants to mortality outcomes, including subgroup analyses across counties stratified by racial composition, poverty levels, rural – urban classification, and U.S. census regions. Mental health distress amplified the negative effects of economic deprivation on mortality. Limited healthcare access constrained preventive interventions. These findings highlight the need for integrated policy solutions to expand mental health services, reduce child poverty, and improve healthcare accessibility in vulnerable communities. KEYWORDS: Premature mortality human capital mental health distress child poverty healthcare access JEL CLASSIFICATION: I12 I14 I18 J24
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了以潜在寿命损失年衡量的过早死亡率的经济与结构性决定因素。利用2014—2020年涵盖2880个美国县及超过20000个县-年观测值的县级面板数据，采用工具变量法处理内生性问题并估计因果效应。每月心理健康不良天数增加10天，与预期寿命缩短1.29年相关，其驱动因素为自杀、药物过量及酒精相关疾病死亡率的上升。儿童贫困率上升5个百分点，通过粮食不安全、不良童年经历及长期慢性健康问题导致预期寿命下降0.72年。每万居民增加一名初级保健提供者可使预期寿命延长0.91年，该效应在经济困难及种族隔离程度较高的县更为显著。分析探究了将这些决定因素与死亡率结果相联系的潜在机制，包括按种族构成、贫困水平、城乡分类及美国人口普查区域分层的县级亚组分析。心理健康困扰放大了经济剥夺对死亡率的负面影响。医疗可及性不足制约了预防性干预措施的实施。这些发现凸显了在脆弱社区扩大心理健康服务、减少儿童贫困及改善医疗可及性的综合政策解决方案的必要性。关键词：过早死亡率 人力资本 心理健康困扰 儿童贫困 医疗可及性 JEL分类：I12 I14 I18 J24
